generation_contract.question_to_answer: Can a second bounded rescue on different strong seeds again produce direct-namespace survivors while preserving mature name identity and recoverability?
generation_contract.biggest_unknown: whether the first rescue's namespace yield generalizes beyond its original four seeds
generation_contract.name_job_focus: long-term umbrella organization; single-token or connected proper-name identity; meaning and mature identity outrank shortness; recoverable pronunciation; commercial .com obtainability is a finalist gate

construction_portfolio.purpose: increase exact-surface distance while retaining the seed's recognizable conceptual core
add a genuine structural anchor rather than decorative branding syllables
preserve meaning through a related morpheme when the original surface is crowded

generation_contract.phonetic_character_brief: Two to four spoken syllables; stable stress and spelling recovery; mature and institution-capable; restrained classical character is acceptable; avoid personal-name, fantasy-name, cute app, biotech-shell, and gimmick-spelling impressions.
anti_collapse_checks: at least three genuinely different operator logics across the batch
no arbitrary doubled letters or meaningless brand suffixes
each result records preserved identity and deliberate change
no Owner-positive historical surface used as a template
no propagation of the first rescue survivor's surface pattern
stop before reality work if the batch collapses into one classical, biotech, fantasy, or app-like shell
generation_contract.stop_condition: Freeze after eight candidates. Run intrinsic/integrity review before namespace triage. Do not generate replacements for failures inside this branch.
